name: nuclear receptor corepressor 2

function.text: NCOR2 encodes nuclear receptor corepressor 2. Annotated molecular activities include transcription corepressor activity and enzyme activator activity. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of miRNA transcription.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Esophageal Adenocarcinoma; Hepatocellular Carcinoma; High-Grade Glioma, NOS. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
